source_title: Half a lifetime after the 1991 reforms: Lotuses bloom in muddy waters
source_excerpt: The reforms of 1991 are seen by many as having been India’s economic launch pad. In his Budget speech of July 24, 1991 — 35 years ago, today — Manmohan Singh quoted Victor Hugo to say “No power on earth can stop an idea whose time has come”, and added: “I suggest to this august House that the emergence of India as a major economic power in the world happens to be one such idea.”
